description: K01 MEDTAS v2.1 authoritative engineering DAG: requirements/interface -> CAD/product definition/MBD -> analysis/drawing/BOM/inspection, with hash-based stale propagation and P007 compiled Product Definition integration.

semantic_payload.purpose: make project zones and migration debt visible; never move existing engineering files automatically

semantic_payload.scope: K01 release requirements used by Gate04E and production release

semantic_payload.authority: controlled project parameter file; UI contains no duplicate engineering literals
control/product/parts.json is the sole product metadata authoring source; CAD custom properties are projections

semantic_payload.source: live SolidWorks API extraction of selected A001 assembly

semantic_payload.policy: one-way parts registry -> SOLIDWORKS custom properties; no manual duplicate metadata authority

semantic_payload.rule: two repeated semantic exports and subsequent no-change native saves must preserve canonical payload hash and MEDTAS STATE_HASH; native binary SHA is diagnostic only

semantic_payload.principle: size/GD&T/datum tolerances should migrate into native MBD/DimXpert so tolerance analysis and drawings consume machine-readable product definition
semantic_payload.fallback_policy: Until authored, existing controlled tolerance seed remains screening-only and MBD node carries a limitation.

semantic_payload.normalization: units + deterministic ordering + canonical semantic identifiers

semantic_payload.method: 1D/2D critical functional chains from canonical dimensions and tolerances
methods: deterministic Monte Carlo when contributor distributions are bound
source_priority: controlled legacy seed only for unported chains

nodes.title: A001 MBD authoring / semantic binding plan

semantic_payload.policy: No automatic MBD write from nominal equality. Unique semantic ownership and reviewed tolerance/datum definition are required before native PMI authoring.

semantic_payload.purpose: bind CAD face signatures to FIXED / PRESSURE / SERVICE_FORCE / CONTACT roles without runtime face IDs

semantic_payload.test: automatic SolidWorks Simulation entity mapping before and after no-op ForceRebuild3(false)
semantic_payload.ambiguity_rule: zero or multiple semantic signature matches => HOLD; never choose first candidate

semantic_payload.purpose: explicitly define an equivalent CalculiX preload/load-path/contact representation before solver comparison

semantic_payload.hash_policy: normalized STEP fingerprint is artifact stability only; geometry equivalence requires CAD semantic checks

semantic_payload.purpose: controlled .inp generation only after mesh, face roles and bolt/preload equivalence are verified

semantic_payload.gate04e: SolidWorks result is sufficient for screening
semantic_payload.production_release: CalculiX cross-check required unless explicitly waived by controlled decision

semantic_payload.screening_acceptance: solver completes and field solution evidence is produced for both 1 A-turn cases
semantic_payload.force_release_acceptance: force extraction must be independently validated before Fz is used as release evidence
semantic_payload.numeric_export: CSV is supplemental; Coil B record is known incomplete and force extraction is not release evidence.

semantic_payload.mbd_policy: Native DimXpert is preferred carrier; reviewed native semantic bindings are explicit transitional authority; OPEN tolerance/process/datum specs remain blockers.
semantic_payload.drawing_release_rule: Any dimensional/GD&T/tolerance characteristic shown on a released drawing must be present in native model PMI/MBD.

semantic_payload.principle: drawing is a derived representation of canonical engineering intent, not an independent source of truth
semantic_payload.authority: native CAD + MBD/DimXpert; drawing is derived presentation

nodes.title: K01-D-006 / P007 first exemplar drawing plan

semantic_payload.policy: all dimensional/GD&T release tolerances must be native PMI/MBD; P007 validates template/manufacturer feedback before batch drawing

semantic_payload.authority: canonical Product Definition; native MBD preferred but reviewed native semantic binding accepted during controlled migration
semantic_payload.policy: Per-drawing release gate. Dimensional/GD&T/tolerance content must be model PMI/MBD; no duplicate manually typed tolerance authority.

semantic_payload.authority: CAD occurrence/quantity + control/product/parts.json metadata; EBOM is computed, never hand-maintained
derived manufacturing view; separate from EBOM
semantic_payload.policy: welded/manufacturing transformations are explicit and fail-closed when decomposition is open

semantic_payload.rule: production baseline is immutable and requires identity, requirement coverage, product-definition artifacts, EBOM, release characteristics and acceptance evidence; independent CalculiX assurance is deferred unless explicitly reactivated

semantic_payload.authority: inspection characteristics project from compiled Product Definition; drawing text is not acceptance authority
controlled P007 exemplar characteristic registry; candidate values are not released tolerances until bound/approved

nodes.title: One-time stable CAD identity migration work order

semantic_payload.policy: read-only work order; no Explorer rename; execution must be reference-safe through SOLIDWORKS and followed by semantic/hash/reference checks

nodes.title: P007 live CAD geometry and legacy-draft reconciliation

semantic_payload.authority: live canonical CAD nominal geometry; legacy drawing text is diagnostic candidate only; conflicts fail closed for drawing release, not for frozen CAD geometry

semantic_payload.policy: materialized semantic/control/evidence bundle; native SOLIDWORKS binaries excluded; content is diagnostic/handoff, never an authority node

nodes.title: P007 compiled Product Definition / drawing-authoring contract

semantic_payload.rule: Compiled semantic contract is derived from controlled requirements/interface/Product Definition decisions. CAD/MBD conformance is a separate downstream binding context consumed by projection/verification, so unrelated CAD edits do not rewrite semantic authority.
semantic_payload.open_rule: OPEN remains OPEN; drawing projection cannot create release semantics.

nodes.title: K01-D-006 controlled projection from compiled P007 Product Definition

semantic_payload.rule: Refine/copy existing linked SLDDRW. Project only compiled controlled Cxx values or explicit nonnumeric OPEN states. If a native drawing semantic carrier is not available in the bounded SW2018 path, emit a controlled PROJECTION_FALLBACK callout and record that carrier class; never invent release semantics.
semantic_payload.manual_scope: 10-20% visual cleanup only; no new engineering semantics
semantic_payload.semantic_pass: all safe_projection_ids must read back in the editable SLDDRW projection evidence
semantic_payload.release_boundary: semantic projection PASS does not override DRAWING_RELEASE_READY or visual QA
